messages:
eli: saw a 5xx burst in eu-west after the midnight quant merge, customers reporting failed batch jobs. Can we fast-track a hotfix? @frank @dana
ops-bot: alert: embeddings-service (eu-west1) 5xx rate 3.1% over 5m, affected route=/v1/embeddings, recent-deploy=quant-merge-0301
frank: I have hotfix branch hotfix/quiet-deser-eu that adds defensive checks and a narrow retry. Staged smoke passed.
dana: oncall approves expedited deploy if we keep canary <=5% and have rollback triggers: abort if 5xx >1% sustained for 8m or error-rate >2x baseline.
eli: approved from product. require temporary route pin to eu-west->hotfix while validating. Frank, can you run?
frank: running: `/deploy hotfix hotfix/quiet-deser-eu --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=8m --pin-route=eu-west=temp-hotfix`
deploy-bot: command received: /deploy hotfix hotfix/quiet-deser-eu --env=eu-west1 --canary=5% --monitor=8m --pin-route=eu-west=temp-hotfix
deploy-bot: starting 5% canary in eu-west1; monitor window 8m. Notifying ops and release channels.
ops-bot: 4m in: canary 5xx=0.2% (baseline 0.25%). traces show defensive path exercised, no timeouts.
dana: expand to 30% and monitor 8m.
frank: scaling: `/deploy scale hotfix/quiet-deser-eu --to=30% --monitor=8m`
deploy-bot: scaling canary to 30% in eu-west1
ops-bot: 3m into 30% window: 5xx=0.27%, p95 latency stable. No infra alerts.
eli: if the full window is clean, promote and leave pin for 1h before unpin.
(9m later)
deploy-bot: canary windows passed. promoting to 100% in eu-west1. route pin applied: eu-west -> hotfix/quiet-deser-eu (temporary)
ops-bot: post-promote checks (5m): 5xx down to 0.07%, p95 back to baseline. No regression flags.
dana: closing expedited approval. Frank please post short release note with commit hash and the revert command for runbook.
frank: release note: "hotfix/quiet-deser-eu (commit 3a9c4d1) - defensive deserialiser + retry; rollforward OK. Revert: /deploy rollback 3a9c4d1 --env=eu-west1"
support: standing by; will hold customer note for 30m stability.
